meta.audience: developers who reach for a small tool many times a day
meta.title: tiny.tools
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/styles/base.css in the app repository), its logo SVG, its sample inputs and its captured screens. Near-black violet #07070B, violet #5B45F0 to lilac #A89BFF, text #F4F3FF / #BDB9DC, mint #58E3A6 for valid; the smart paste pad and the JSON tool are the real app at 2x.

source.notes: 14 small developer tools in one place, all in the browser; smart paste recognises JSON, JWT, URL, Base64, timestamps, colours and UUIDs and opens the right tool
the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json: the smart paste pad answering four pastes, the JSON tool before and after 정리하기, four more tools
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (code, labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's tokens: #07070B / #0E0E15 grounds, text #F4F3FF / #BDB9DC / #908CB1, violet #5B45F0 and #7A66FF, lilac #A89BFF / #CFC7FF (its gradient and its caret), mint #58E3A6 for a valid result.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 800 with -0.055em for headlines (the app's hero: 필요한 만큼만, / 매일 쓰는 도구. with its lilac caret), JetBrains Mono for code, numbers and labels.
rationale.motion: Quick and exact, like a good tool: tiles snap into a grid on the beat, a paste lands and the pad answers at once, a minified line unfolds into formatted JSON under a scan line.
rationale.sound: Chiptune in D major at 128 BPM (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s): tiny square-wave bleeps for a box of tiny tools, digital SFX for pastes and key presses.
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the name and the app's line beside the fourteen tools snapping into place; the real smart paste pad recognising a JSON, a JWT and a colour; the JSON tool formatting a minified line in the browser; the end card. The 30 s cut adds four more tools.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
